findings.text: Type assertion changed from `obj.(Mock)` to `obj.(*Mock)`, breaking the deprecated path where callers pass `myMock.Mock` (a value). With input `AssertExpectationsForObjects(t, myMock.Mock)`, the assertion fails, `obj` is not converted to `*Mock`, and the subsequent `obj.(assertExpectationser)` call may panic or fail since a `Mock` value was never converted to its pointer.
